snippet.title: The Cleaner: Prologue — Official Demo Trailer | Atmospheric Point & Click Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
The Cleaner: Prologue is a hand-drawn atmospheric point & click puzzle game made with Godot 4.
🎮 Wishlist & Play the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4443000

The Cleaner is a hand-drawn atmospheric puzzle game where sound guides the journey.

Follow Taki, a small bird traveling through a living paper world inspired by nature. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover clues hidden in sound, and explore levels that are living creatures.

The Cleaner: Prologue introduces the first chapter of the journey — a quiet beginning where observation, listening, and interaction shape the experience.

This is a non-violent, nature-inspired adventure designed around immersion, sound, and meaningful exploration.

Add The Cleaner to your wishlist and continue the journey.

Made with Godot 4 / Godot Engine
Hand-drawn watercolor 2D animation
Atmospheric point and click puzzle adventure
Sound-based gameplay
Indie game by two7two studio
